'''''Schwa''''' was a pair of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] that arrived to take cargo from a shipyard, where the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Kotiate]]'' was present.
